# Test shared libraries loaded at run time with //cgo:dynload types and
# hand-written bindings.

env GOEXPERIMENT=$GOEXPERIMENT,runtimecgopurego,cgobindings
[!GOEXPERIMENT:cgobindings] skip
[!GOOS:darwin] [!GOOS:linux] skip
[!GOARCH:amd64] [!GOARCH:arm64] skip
[!exec:cc] skip

mkdir lib
cc -fPIC -shared -o lib/libmul.so c/mul.c
[GOOS:linux] cc -fPIC -shared -o lib/libadd.so c/add.c -ldl
[!GOOS:linux] cc -fPIC -shared -o lib/libadd.so c/add.c

cd dyn
env CGO_ENABLED=bindings
env CC=/bin/false
env LIBMUL=$PWD/../lib/libmul.so
env LIBADD=$PWD/../lib/libadd.so
go run .
stdout '^mul: compute=42 counter=7 name=mul$'
stdout '^add: compute=13 counter=7 name=add$'
stdout '^mul: counter=8$'
stdout '^add: counter=7$'
stdout '^local: ok$'
stdout '^missing: ok$'
stdout '^init: ok$'
stdout '^directives: ok$'
stdout '^concurrent: ok$'

-- c/mul.c --
int Counter = 7;
int Compute(int a, int b) { return a * b; }
int MulOnlySym(void) { return 123; }
void Bump(void) { Counter++; }

-- c/add.c --
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <dlfcn.h>

int Counter = 7;
int Compute(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
int GlobalSeesMulOnly(void) { return dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "MulOnlySym") != 0; }
void Bump(void) { Counter++; }

-- dyn/go.mod --
module dyn

go 1.28

-- dyn/a_init.go --
package main

import (
	"os"
	"runtime/cgo"
)

// pkgCalc is opened while initializing package variables, and initCalc by
// an init function in a file that is compiled before the code generated by
// cmd/cgo. Open must resolve their symbols in both cases.
var pkgCalc, pkgErr = cgo.Open[Calc](os.Getenv("LIBMUL"))

var initCalc *Calc

func init() {
	var err error
	initCalc, err = cgo.Open[Calc](os.Getenv("LIBMUL"))
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

-- dyn/b_directives.go --
package main

import _ "embed"

// The first declarations of a file keep their directives.

//go:embed data.txt
var data string

//go:noinline
func dataLen() int { return len(data) }

-- dyn/c_noimports.go --
package main

//go:noinline
func two() int { return 2 }

-- dyn/data.txt --
hello
-- dyn/lib.go --
package main

import "C"
import "runtime/cgo"

//cgo:dynload Calc
//cgo:func Calc.Compute Compute
//cgo:func Calc.Bump Bump
//cgo:var Calc.Counter Counter

// Calc is the API shared by libmul.so and libadd.so.
type Calc struct {
	cgo.Library
	name string
}

func (*Calc) Compute(a, b int32) int32

func (*Calc) Bump()

func (*Calc) Counter() *int32

//cgo:dynload MulOnly
//cgo:func MulOnly.MulOnlySym MulOnlySym

// MulOnly is the API only provided by libmul.so.
type MulOnly struct {
	cgo.Library
}

func (*MulOnly) MulOnlySym() int32

//cgo:dynload AddOnly
//cgo:func AddOnly.GlobalSeesMulOnly GlobalSeesMulOnly

// AddOnly is the API only provided by libadd.so.
type AddOnly struct {
	cgo.Library
}

func (*AddOnly) GlobalSeesMulOnly() int32

-- dyn/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"runtime/cgo"
	"strings"
	"sync"
)

func open(path, name string) *Calc {
	c, err := cgo.Open[Calc](path)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	c.name = name
	return c
}

func main() {
	mul := open(os.Getenv("LIBMUL"), "mul")
	add := open(os.Getenv("LIBADD"), "add")
	for _, c := range []*Calc{mul, add} {
		fmt.Printf("%s: compute=%d counter=%d name=%s\n", c.name, c.Compute(6, 7), *c.Counter(), c.name)
	}

	// Each instance refers to its own library's variables.
	mul.Bump()
	fmt.Printf("mul: counter=%d\n", *mul.Counter())
	fmt.Printf("add: counter=%d\n", *add.Counter())

	// Libraries are loaded locally (RTLD_LOCAL), so a symbol exported by
	// libmul.so must not leak into the global symbol namespace seen by
	// libadd.so via dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, ...).
	mulOnly, err := cgo.Open[MulOnly](os.Getenv("LIBMUL"))
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if got := mulOnly.MulOnlySym(); got != 123 {
		fmt.Printf("MulOnlySym() = %d, want 123\n", got)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	addOnly, err := cgo.Open[AddOnly](os.Getenv("LIBADD"))
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if got := addOnly.GlobalSeesMulOnly(); got != 0 {
		fmt.Printf("GlobalSeesMulOnly() = %d, want 0 (RTLD_LOCAL violated)\n", got)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("local: ok")

	// Open resolves all symbols when it loads the library, so it fails if
	// one of them is missing.
	if l, err := cgo.Open[MulOnly](os.Getenv("LIBADD")); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "cannot resolve symbol MulOnlySym") {
		fmt.Printf("Open[MulOnly](libadd.so) = %v, %v, want cannot resolve symbol MulOnlySym error\n", l, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("missing: ok")

	if pkgErr != nil || pkgCalc.Compute(2, 3) != 6 || initCalc.Compute(2, 3) != 6 {
		fmt.Printf("Calc opened during initialization: %v\n", pkgErr)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("init: ok")

	if dataLen() != len("hello\n") || two() != 2 {
		fmt.Printf("dataLen() = %d, two() = %d\n", dataLen(), two())
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("directives: ok")

	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	errs := make(chan string, 64)
	for i := range 32 {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			c, want := mul, int32(i*3)
			if i%2 == 1 {
				c, want = add, int32(i+3)
			}
			if got := c.Compute(int32(i), 3); got != want {
				errs <- fmt.Sprintf("%s.Compute(%d, 3) = %d, want %d", c.name, i, got, want)
			}
		}()
	}
	wg.Wait()
	close(errs)
	for e := range errs {
		fmt.Println(e)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("concurrent: ok")
}
